[Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “不过，看过很多政治文章对他害得，他有很多问题。” Formula: Subject + 看了/阅读了 + object + 以后，+ subject + 产生/有 + 疑问 Correct: “不过，看了很多政治文章以后，他产生了很多疑问。” “害得” must be followed by a result, such as “害得他很担心.” Here, “产生了很多疑问” naturally expresses that reading led him to have many questions.
